description: This file defines an abstract class 'WebOrDesktopDevice' that provides an implementation for device interactions within a web or desktop environment. It manages storage, database operations, keychain values, and device lifecycle methods, serving as a base class for concrete implementations.

classes.name: WebOrDesktopDevice
classes.description: An abstract class providing device functionalities for web or desktop applications, including storage management, database handling, keychain management, and lifecycle controls.

methods.name: setApplication
methods.description: Associates an application instance with the device and initializes related database.

methods.name: getJsonParsedRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value by key and attempts to parse it as JSON.

methods.name: databaseForIdentifier
methods.description: Finds the database instance corresponding to a given application identifier.

methods.name: clearAllDataFromDevice
methods.description: Clears all device data, including keychain and storage, and optionally kills the application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes all databases associated with the device.

methods.name: getRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value from local storage.

methods.name: setRawStorageValue
methods.description: Sets a raw storage value in local storage.

methods.name: removeRawStorageValue
methods.description: Removes a specific item from local storage.

methods.name: removeAllRawStorageValues
methods.description: Clears all local storage data.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens and initializes a database for a specific application identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseLoadChunks
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts database entries into chunks based on priority.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Fetches all payloads from the database for a given application identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Retrieves specific payloads for given keys from the database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Saves a single payload to the database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Saves multiple payloads to the database.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific payload by id from the database.

methods.name: removeAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Clears all payloads for a given database.

methods.name: getNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves the keychain value for a specific application identifier.

methods.name: setNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets the keychain value for a specific application identifier.

methods.name: clearNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Deletes the keychain value for a specific application identifier.

methods.name: setRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a raw keychain value.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in a new browser tab.

methods.name: getKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to get keychain data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to set keychain data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: clearRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to clear raw keychain data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isDeviceDestroyed
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the device is destroyed, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: performHardReset
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a hard reset of the device, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: performSoftReset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset by reloading the page.
